أستوجب (form X)
# أَسْتَوْجِبُ (ʔastawjibu) /ʔas.taw.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# أُسْتَوْجَبُ (ʔustawjabu) /ʔus.taw.d͡ʒa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# أَسْتَوْجِبَ (ʔastawjiba) /ʔas.taw.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# أُسْتَوْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
